name: ailert-platform
description: AiLert Professional Newsletter Platform - Microservices Architecture

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:services && npm run test:shared
scripts.test:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm test -- --silent --coverage); done
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit -- --ci && npm run test:integration -- --ci && npm run test:e2e -- --ci
scripts.lint: npm run lint:services && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run lint); done
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:services:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix
scripts.lint:services:fix: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run lint:fix); done
scripts.format: npm run format:services && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run format); done
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:services && npm run type-check:frontend
scripts.type-check:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run type-check); done
scripts.db:migrate: docker-compose exec user-service npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec user-service npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U ailert -d ailert -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
scripts.docs:generate: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run docs); done

author: AiLert Team

hooks.pre-push: npm run test && npm run lint
